about: Reviewed phrases for composed Explain answers (src/compose.ts). The model picks ids; the server writes: The words "<mark>" <does>[, and <does>]. The sentence does not say <unsaid list>. Each 'does' phrase starts with a base-form verb and describes what the marked wording does to a reader; each 'unsaid' item completes 'The sentence does not say ...'. No phrase says or hints that a claim is true or false, judges a person, group or side, or names anyone. Drafted and reviewed per move group, then checked across all moves, on 2026-10-07; a change to this file is a reviewed change.
